newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat called up 5 to 7 cents on USDA data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat called up 5 to 7 cents on USDA data.

text.p: Nearby CBOT wheat futures were called to open five to seven cents higher on bullish wheat seeding data from USDA.

It reported that wheat seedings were 48.222 million acres, which was well below trade expectations for 50 to 53 million acres. As a result, some traders see new-crop wheat contracts up eight to 10 cents per bushel on the open.
"It's going to be all about the spreads in wheat today (Friday) said one floor trader."
The quaterly USDA wheat stocks figure of 1.219 billion bushels was seen as slightly negative by some traders.
